evidence.claim: Frontdoor reports that it is a leading U.S. home warranty and new home builder warranty provider, with approximately 2.1 million active home warranties, approximately 3.8 million annual home warranty service requests, and a nationwide contractor network of approximately 17,000 independent professional contractor firms.

Frontdoor disclosed that 76% of 2025 revenue was generated through existing customer renewals and that 84% of home warranty customers were on monthly auto-pay, supporting the recurring-service-rail angle.

AppFolio describes its platform as a cloud-based operating platform for property managers managing single-family, multifamily, affordable, commercial, student, and community-association properties, with workflows for accounting, leasing, maintenance, payments, tenant screening, and risk mitigation.
AppFolio’s 2025 10-K describes maintenance tools that automate service-request intake, triage, resident communication, and work-order generation, directly mapping to rental maintenance workflows.

EverCommerce says its EverPro home and field-service solutions serve more than 350,000 home-services businesses and are made for tradespeople, field-service businesses, home-improvement professionals, and remodelers.

EverCommerce may be a second-order repair/remodel beneficiary if high housing friction shifts consumer spending from moving/new purchases toward maintaining and improving existing homes, but segment-level durability needs verification.
Porch lists software and services for inspectors, moving, utilities, contractors, real estate, warranty, title and closing, and mortgage industries.

Porch may be an underappreciated housing-service rail because it touches inspection, move-in, utility, contractor, warranty, and title/closing workflows, but its insurance exposure and profitability profile make it a speculative-shadow candidate pending deeper financial checks.

First American Data & Analytics markets property datasets spanning 100% of the U.S. housing market, using title data assets, public record documents, title plant data management, and property-related records such as mortgages, deeds, assignments, and liens.
